title: Look up values in a map
objective: Make a map from keys to values, look a value up by its key, and change a value.

body.text: A map pairs each key with a value. make a map from builds one from key to value pairs, separated by commas. Look a value up with the map's name, at, and the key, as in ages at "Bo". size of gives the number of pairs.

body.title: Look up an age
body.code:
make ages equal to a map from "Ana" to 11, "Bo" to 12
say ages at "Bo"
say "There are {size of ages} people"

body.text: A map can be changed with set, the same way as a list, if it was made changing. Here Ana's age goes up by one.

body.title: Change a value
body.code:
make changing ages equal to a map from "Ana" to 11
set ages at "Ana" to 12
say ages at "Ana"

body.prompt: The program prints Ana's age, but it should print Bo's age, 14.
body.starter:
make ages equal to a map from "Ana" to 11, "Bo" to 14
say ages at "Ana"
body.solution:
make ages equal to a map from "Ana" to 11, "Bo" to 14
say ages at "Bo"
